readout_other: open field, CatWalk gait, beam walking; 9.4T MRI infarct and edema; ELISA and immunofluorescence for microglial polarization, angiogenesis, neurogenesis
direction_notes: LITUS reduced infarct and edema and improved motor function in MCAO rats and shifted microglia from M1 to M2; neuronal excitability was not measured.

device.manufacturer: GreenValley BrainTech (Shenzhen) Medical Technology Co., Ltd

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed 1 MHz, tone burst 200 us, duty cycle 20%, 1-s stimulus repeated every 2 s; 30 min daily for six consecutive days starting 24 h after MCAO.

source_quotes.n_subjects: They were randomly assigned to three groups (n = 10 per group): Control, MCAO, and MCAO + LITUS.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Daily 30- min treatments were conducted for six consecutive days
